decision: The full action-direction grid did not establish useful model ranking or gradients: 404 eligible comparisons, 49.5% sign agreement, cluster95CI44.2-54.5%. Do not spend long actor training on this unaccepted SM path. Run two real PPO baselines and two RSSM coverage/fitting seeds, retaining unchanged prediction and physical gates.
scope: PPO headroom and RSSM action coverage/model adaptation; not a PPO-versus-SM efficiency claim
known_limits: RSSM32-episode stability is not a proof of improvement
Stronger representation penalty did not demonstrate improved actor behavior
Action-direction acceptance must be rerun on a selected adapted model before SM policy updates
No locked final test has been opened
